title: Count the vowels
statement: Write a function `countVowels(text)` that returns how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) appear in the text. Uppercase and lowercase both count. For example, `countVowels('Hello World')` returns 3.
fallbackHints: What question do you need to ask about every single letter in the text?
Go through the text one character at a time and keep a tally. Think about how to make capital and small letters count the same way before you compare.
You need a way to ask whether a character belongs to a small collection of vowels. A string has a method that answers yes or no to 'do you contain this?'. Decide where the tally should go up.
